Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 3a) demonstrates a right-sided pneumothorax with the visceral pleura separated from the chest wall. The azygos lobe, identified by the arrow pointing to the azygos fissure, has shifted laterally along with the collapsed lung, and the characteristic teardrop-shaped opacity of the azygos vein is not visible at the caudal end of the fissure in this projection due to the displacement and air in the pleural space.
